title: Settings
description: Manage your account, monitoring and access to GreenER.
signIn: Sign in to manage your account. Administrative sections require an administrator account.
denied: Only administrators can access this section.
preferencesDescription: Energy, CO₂e, coverage limits and analysis defaults remain in Methodology and my preferences.
accountSecurity: Passwords, tokens and authentication codes are never displayed here.
sessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign in again.
loadFailed: The request could not be completed. Your changes were preserved. Try again.
previousData: Previous data is displayed. The latest update failed.
interval: Collection interval: {{count, number}} s · configured in the environment
refreshNote: Updating the diagnosis does not start collection.
noSources: No source diagnosis is available. Absence does not mean healthy.
noCycles: No cycle is recorded. This does not indicate normal operation.
pauseDescription: New cycles will be suspended. A running cycle may finish. Monitored applications continue running. Pausing may create gaps in the history.
resumeDescription: New cycles will be scheduled again. Gaps from the paused period remain in the history.
auditDescription: Review who performed an action, its reason and recorded result.
noEvents: No events found in this query.
createDescription: The account requires email confirmation. Its owner sets the password using the existing activation flow. Creation does not automatically send email.
accessChangeDescription: Access changes may revoke sessions. History and authorship are preserved. Review and confirm before applying.
conflict: The account changed or this operation is not allowed. Refresh its state before trying again. No change was applied.
noResults: No results for the selected filters.
